milestones.name: bounded proof-carrying integer dataflow language
milestones.scope: Exact finite signed-64-bit integer/bool topological DAG only; max 64 nodes, 16 assertions; no runtime/environment semantics.

design_revisions: Finite execution substitutes are now versioned by exact closed semantics and distinguish FAIL from UNSUPPORTED instead of hand-waving omitted operations.

Compaction retry semantics now have a live stale-boundary 409 fixture: a failed stale CAS must reconstruct current authority and recompute the segment boundary; simply swapping in a fresh SHA for the stale candidate is forbidden.
The stale content-addressed segment can remain orphaned without corrupting publication state and may later be GC'd after reachability checks.
still_unresolved: arbitrary environment-sensitive compile/test/dependency execution without a hosted executor
opaque non-idempotent external effects without stable idempotency/reconciliation identity
binary storage beyond low-volume text without quota-bearing route
protected or privileged authority unavailable to scheduled Chat

frontier.action: Classify current authorized write surfaces using only public API contracts/tool schemas into natural-idempotent, caller-keyed, query-reconcilable, or opaque; produce safe retry recipes and hard-gates.

Add malformed/overflow/forward-reference controls to bounded-int-dataflow-v1 and test whether a tiny acyclic dataflow certificate can express one additional real finite check without expanding the operation set.
Add reachability-based orphan GC fixture for the stale unreferenced segment, using current publication head as root set; interruption/duplicate retry must remain safe.

exact_next_action: Using public/current connector contracts only, inspect GitHub content mutations and other available authorized write schemas for caller-stable idempotency keys or stable queryable identities. Persist a role-local effect-class matrix with retry algorithm per class. Do not perform side effects outside isolated own-state fixtures; classify opaque sends/creates as hard-gated unless the contract exposes reconciliation identity.
